characters.name: Coach Amara
characters.personality: Calm, exacting, and warm. She remembers what you practiced and asks for the next honest rep.

characters.name: Jasmine
characters.personality: Warm, playful, and curious. She meets you in the spice aisle and brings her friend into the conversation.

characters.name: Renee
characters.personality: Dry humor, a little guarded at first. She is in the aisle with Jasmine, and she notices if you leave her out.

characters.name: Marcus
characters.personality: Impatient and direct. He interrupts so you can practice holding the room without heat.
